name: Antimagic Burst
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a tiny mirror)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 80-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Antimagic burst causes a globe of force to explode silently from a point you select. All creatures in the globe are sickened for 1d6 rounds and take 6d6 force damage. A summoned creature takes double damage. A successful Reflex save negates the sickening and reduces the damage by half.

A construct caught within the globe takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 25d6), or half damage if a Reflex save is successful. Constructs can’t be immune to this spell even though it has spell resistance.

Any summoned creature not destroyed by the spell is subject to a dispel magic effect.
